mechanism: Collect ticks (TickSave or external CSV Bid stream); EqualVolumeBars EA packs every TicksInBar price changes into one OHLC bar written to an offline .hst chart (!EqvSYMBOL+n). Bar width in time expands/contracts with activity; chart time is synthetic (from 1970, 1 bar = 1 minute) so analysis is on activity-equal bars not clock bars.

why_new_for_mis: Activity-normalized bar clock: liquidity/participation denseness defines the bar, so MIS can sense structure on equal-information bars instead of fixed time.
quote: in our case it will consist in balancing bars by constructing them from the same number of ticks. Thus a bar will be calculated not in time (the number of minutes), but in the number of price changes.

mechanism: Within ~48 bars find TD pivots: High[i]>High[i±1] and High[i]>Close[i+2] (troughs mirrored). Need two pivots with right lower/higher for down/up. Verity #3: close of bar right of last TD-point must lie beyond projected TD-line speed V=(P2-P1)/(i2-i1). Draw last true TD trend as thick solid, nearest opposite prior as thin dotted; extend 10 bars left via buffers.
data_needed: High/Low/Close and bar times on chart TF; search window ~48 bars (~2 days on H1).
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: chart window indicator; search coded as 48 hours / 2 days
why_new_for_mis: Objective Demark TD-line regime sensor with explicit verity test and last-vs-prior style encoding—current trend state plus nearest contrary structure for MIS.
quote: the last direction of the trend is drawn with a thick solid line, and it won't be odd for the analysis of the current state to know the nearest preceding direction of the trend, which is drawn with a thin dotted line.

mechanism: Compare |Δ| of MACD main on bars a,b,c (a=start, b=a+1, c=b+1): r1=|Macd_a|-|Macd_b|, r2=|Macd_b|-|Macd_c|. Classify below/above axis into down/up with acceleration, slowing, or constant accel; reverse-down/up; axis up/down-cross with accel/slow; near-zero flat if both consecutive |Δ|<0.0002. Alerts state for trading or history (extern bar a, period).

quote: if the value of the difference between the current and the preceding bar exceeds the value of the difference between the values of the preceding and the pre-preceding bar, then the trend is growing with positive acceleration.

mechanism: Stage 1: classic TrailingStop to move SL to/near breakeven and optionally step TP by March*(TrailingStop/2). Stage 2 once SL≥open (long): Coeff_up=(Bid-Open)*0.382; New_SL=Bid-Coeff_up-margin; trail SL under price by Demark 0.382 correction depth (short mirrored). Optional close if price retreats after hitting planned TakeProfit.
